rules.rule: New managed source drafts retain their independent craft editor before first plan adoption, without changing legacy source versions or stored selections.
rules.source: 2026-11-14 Acceptance regression repair authorization; docs/engineering/development-draft-craft-version.md; approved PR08 source-specific rollout.
rules.initialization: No migration. Existing plan version takes priority. No-plan managed source uses immutable creation marker; publishing current company settings does not upgrade older sources. Copy creates own new identity. Original fixtures and owned resource cleanup.
rules.dateAndPermission: No new dates, adopted plan, actual work or clocks are generated by reading a draft. Original source ownership, craft reference validation and quotation row privileges unchanged; original App unauthorized-write and same-session revoked-role checks pass.
rules.expectation: First save, reopen and repeated save preserve printing plus ordered special crafts and new editor; legacy draft stays legacy. Native dispatch, quotation, adoption, historical version and permissions remain valid.

checks.context: Actual candidate working tree; Node22/npm10, canonical configs. Browser and native PG16 owned marked low-privilege isolated database, maxWorkers1, cleanup verified; unit maxWorkers2. No production or Acceptance writes.
